description_en: Submitting an HTML translation task with Tongyi Multimodal Translation
description_zh: 通义多模态翻译提交html翻译任务
kebab_example: aliyun anytrans submit-html-translate-task --workspace-id llm-kqtrcpdee4xm29xx --format text --source-language zh --target-language en --text '!DOCTYPE_html_html_lang=_zh-CN_head_meta_charset=_UTF-8_meta_name=_viewport_content=_width=device-width,_initial-scale=1.0_title_我的第一个网页_/title_/head_body_h1_欢迎来到我的网页！_/h1_p_这是一个简单的_HTML_页面。_/p_p_学习_HTML_是进入网页开发的第一步。_/p_a_href=_https://www.example.com_点击这里访问示例网站_/a_/body_/html' --scene mt-turbo --ext '{"sensitives":["password"],"terminologies":[{"tgt":"ML","src":"机器学习"}],"examples":[{"tgt":"hello","src":"你好"}],"domainHint":"his_sentence_from_an_e-commerce_product_image,_please_provide_a_translation_that_is_both_highly_concise_and_no_more_than_1.2_times_the_length_of_the_original.","config":{"skipCsiCheck":false,"callbackUrl":"example-string"},"paramMap":"bizUserld_:_123456_,_bizType_:session","textTransform":{"toTitle":false,"toLower":false,"toUpper":false},"trackingData":"traceId_:_trace_123456"}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitHtmlTranslateTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Model Studio workspace used for this request
parameters.help_zh: 当前请求所使用的百炼业务空间 id
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The format of the input text
parameters.name: format

parameters.example:
欢迎来到我的网页！

这是一个简单的 HTML 页面。

学习 HTML 是进入网页开发的第一步。

点击这里访问示例网站
parameters.help_en: The HTML content to be translated
parameters.name: text

element_fields.help_en: The target text in the example
element_fields.name: tgt

element_fields.help_en: The source text in the example
element_fields.name: src

fields.example: his sentence from an e-commerce product image, please provide a translation that is both highly concise and no more than 1.2 times the length of the original.
fields.help_en: A natural language prompt in English to guide the model's translation style
fields.help_zh: 领域提示（一段英文自然语言文本，用于指示大模型翻译的风格）
fields.name: domain_hint

fields.help_en: A list of sensitive words to filter from the translation
fields.name: sensitives

element_fields.help_en: The target text for the terminology pair
element_fields.name: tgt

element_fields.help_en: The source text for the terminology pair
element_fields.name: src

fields.help_en: A list of custom terminology pairs to apply to the translation
fields.name: terminologies

fields.help_en: Converts the entire translated text to lowercase
fields.name: to_lower

fields.help_en: Converts the entire translated text to uppercase
fields.name: to_upper

fields.help_en: Converts the translated text to title case
fields.help_zh: 译文全转为 capitalized 首字母大写
fields.name: to_title

fields.help_en: Specifies case transformations for the translated text
fields.name: text_transform

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to skip the Content Moderation check. To skip this check, you must first complete the Content Moderation disablement process before calling the API
fields.help_zh: 是否跳过绿网检测（如果需要跳过绿网检测，需要先完成绿网关闭流程后再调用）
fields.name: skip_csi_check

fields.help_en: The callback URL for receiving translation results
fields.name: callback_url

fields.help_en: Provides specific configuration settings for the translation task
fields.name: config

fields.help_en: Provides extended parameter configuration. The `bizUserId` key specifies the business user ID to isolate custom terminology enforcement by user. The `bizType` key specifies the business scenario type to isolate custom terminology enforcement by scenario
fields.help_zh:
扩展参数配置（bizUserld：业务层面的用户ID，用来区分不
同业务用户，做到“按用户隔离”的术语干预，互不影响。
bizType：业务场景类型/标识，用来区分不同场景，做到
“按场景隔离”的术语干预，互不影响。）
fields.name: param_map

fields.help_en: Custom passthrough data that the service returns unprocessed in the response. Useful for tasks such as event tracking
fields.help_zh: 用户自定义透传数据，翻译服务不做处理，原样返回，用于埋点等场景
fields.name: tracking_data

parameters.help_en: Extended parameters to control translation behavior
parameters.help_zh: 控制翻译功能的扩展参数
parameters.name: ext
